title: Remove deprecated CodeWiki skill surfaces
summary: Make package skill discovery expose only decision, planning, and implementation workflow skills by removing generic router/validation skill folders and moving required invariant prose to prompt/docs.

goal.outcome: Only codewiki-decision, codewiki-planning, and codewiki-implementation remain discoverable package skills.
acceptance: Package skill discovery and source-contract tests report exactly the three normal workflow skills.
`skills/codewiki/**` and `skills/codewiki-validation/**` no longer remain as package-discoverable folders, hidden aliases, or shim skills.
Bootstrap/router/validation guidance needed by agents is moved to prompt contract, package docs, or non-skill docs.
Prompt contract describes three loops plus gates, not a four-loop validation workflow.
No package source imports from `src/validation/**`; all references use `src/gateway/**` or public API contracts.
`src/validation/**` is removed rather than retained as a compatibility shim root.
File-structure/source-contract no longer treat `src/validation/**` as an active source root except historical refs.
Gateway preflight/report semantics and pass/fail/block output remain unchanged.
non_goals: Do not rename gateway back to validation-loop terminology.
Do not change task-close/ship-ready policy except import/root cleanup.

delta.desired:
Three discoverable workflow skills only.
Refinement: Additional outcome: Gateway owns validation code directly and the deprecated `src/validation/**` source root is removed without behavior loss.
Refinement: No deprecated validation shim source root remains.
delta.current:
skills/codewiki and skills/codewiki-validation still exist after accepted no-shim decision.
Refinement: src/validation/** exists as @deprecated re-export shims to gateway.
delta.closure:
Tests and source-contract/package audits prove only three workflow skills remain.
Refinement: Imports, tests, file-structure, and source-contract audits pass without src/validation source root.
